Name: Elishaphat, Son of Zichri
Summary: Elishaphat, son of Zichri, was one of the captains of hundreds Jehoiada took into covenant to crown Joash.
KeyStory: Jehoiada took Elishaphat the son of Zichri into covenant with him.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Zichri, Father of Elishaphat
LifeLesson: The captains who guarded the king guarded the promise.
